summary: RF Acquisition Corp II, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval to amend its investment management trust agreement. The amendment allows up to six monthly extensions of the business-combination deadline from August 15, 2026, to February 15, 2027, each requiring a $75,000 deposit into the trust in exchange for a non-interest-bearing unsecured promissory note. It also eliminates the company's right to withdraw up to $100,000 of trust interest for liquidation expenses. This is a routine SPAC extension filing, not a merger announcement; watch for future business-combination announcements or redemption triggers.
